orders.changes:
Re-ran the round 8 leg reshape on body-0400 and fixed the two side effects that got it reverted. The y pass is now masked behind the leg, which removes the dent in the tail tip. The x-warp fade moved below the thigh, which removes the thigh band. The shin ripple bands are gone, the calf back line leans forward by about .008, and the calf corner is rounder.

R08.5 to R08.8 still pass: .990, .985, 1.036, .954. R08.10 is .8293 against .829 before. R08.11 fell from .6422 to .6301 and still fails. The slimmer back edge overlaps the sheet less, which is the placement friction already noted in the R08 spec.

One thing is not fixed. In the hind paw profile closeup (m09) there is a faint horizontal line on the ankle near the bottom of the zBlur fade (z -.80 to -.86) that the baseline does not have. The build budget was spent. The posed measurement used the baseline pose and joints, without a refit.

The assembly check passes with 1 component and 0 nonmanifold edges. The diff lists R08 to R12 as changed. m10 tails are unchanged apart from render noise. Commit 808660d7 holds the code changes, and build.json is in the packet.
